rawContent: When I was in Ferguson recently my friend Traci Blackmon took me to see how people are living, healing and making resilient movements happen. Still: This dove, and a yellow square I just couldn’t photograph mark the spot on which Mike Brown died. RIP Mike. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ZBXShyilTD

I’m one of those women, #metoo. Touched inappropriately as a child, thingified. Treated as though there was something in it for me—like I’d enjoy the betrayal of my trust.

When you tell someone—the way you were grabbed, the way you squeezed your legs tight—there is silence.

I’m one of those women, #MeToo. Offered a ride home by the man-in-charge so he can be alone with me—he’s going my way.

Folks are watching and what’s my problem so I get in the cab but bring a colleague who’s going south so I won’t be alone.
